script:
test -f "$F/outside.txt"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/workspace/%2e%2e/outside.txt" --expect 400 --check detail eq 'Path is outside the workspace' --save F16.traversal-rejected/dotdot
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/workspace/..%2Foutside.txt" --expect 400 --check detail eq 'Path is outside the workspace'
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/workspace/sub/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/etc/hostname" --expect 400
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/workspace//etc/hostname" --expect 400 --check detail eq 'Path is outside the workspace' --save F16.traversal-rejected/absolute
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/workspace/%2Fetc%2Fhostname" --expect 400 --check detail eq 'Path is outside the workspace'
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/workspace/sub/%2e%2e/data.json" --expect 200 --check qa eq f16 --save F16.traversal-rejected/inside-dotdot
